gizmo.title: Wasan ƙwaƙwalwa
gizmo.description: Juya katuna don samun biyu-biyu. Haɗa kalma da ma'anarta don dacewa ta nuna fahimta, ko yi amfani da rubutu ko hotuna biyu masu kama.

configure.title: Take
configure.description: Umarnin da ake nunawa a kai, misali: Haɗa kalmar da aikinta.

configure.title: Biyu-biyu
configure.description: Kowane biyu katuna biyu ne da suka dace da juna, galibi kalma da ma'anarta. Gefe yana buƙatar rubutu, hoto, ko duka biyu.

advanced.title: Launin ƙawa
advanced.description: Launi na zaɓi don guntun kai, bayan katuna da maɓallin.
